title: AS2 ClassDecl: implements clause parsed but ActionImplementsOp (0x2b) never emitted
description: Parser correctly populates ClassDecl.interfaces but compileClassDecl in compiler.ts ignores it entirely. AVM1 ActionImplementsOp (0x2b) is required for instanceof checks against interfaces. In packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts compileClassDecl — decl.interfaces array is never read.
